de.abas.erp.db.selection

Class RowSelectionBuilder<HEAD extends AbasObject,ROW extends SelectableRecord & RowRecord>

  • Object
    • SelectionBuilder<ROW>
      • RowSelectionBuilder<HEAD,ROW>
  • Type Parameters:
    HEAD - Head type
    ROW - Row type

    public final class RowSelectionBuilder<HEAD extends AbasObject,ROW extends SelectableRecord & RowRecord>
extends SelectionBuilder<ROW>
    An instance of this class describes a selection for rows in a connected database. It defines conditions and options which restricts the result set.
    Author:
    mm
